findings.message: 4 tl.fromTo() calls target "#mbb" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 34.941s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 395 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.
